summary: Walks a linked list whose head pointer is stored at this+0x13C, following each node's next pointer at node+0x24. For every node whose time-cap pointer at node+0x1C is non-null, calls TimerBasedStateUpdateWithCap on that node with this as the second argument.

local_names.i: current node pointer in the walk

operations.description: For loop starting at the head pointer this+0x13C (this[79]); continues while the current node is non-null, advancing to the next pointer stored at node+0x24.
The update is applied only when the node's time-cap pointer at node+0x1C is non-null; nodes without a configured cap are skipped.
TimerBasedStateUpdateWithCap updates the node's state with its timer, capped at the configured duration; called during this walk, which itself runs inside SceneNodeStateUpdateWithTransform (caller).
